headline: Northern Trust Universe Data: Strong Global Equity Markets Drive Institutional Investor Gains in Second Quarter of 2026
summary: CHICAGO, July 29, 2026--The largest asset owners in the Northern Trust Universe posted a median return of 6.6% for Q2 2026.
